title: Teleportation Curse
do_not_publish: Private study copy of craftee_films' reel. Never post.

shots.text: The teacher asked her to name a planet,
and for some reason, she said my name.
Suddenly, I was standing next to her desk.
That night, I was brushing my teeth when it happened again.
I landed at her family's dinner table
Her mom asked if I was staying for dessert.
On Wednesday, she yelled my name
and woke up in the middle of her sleepover.
Her best friend turned to her.
I just asked who you liked.
My crush hid her face in a pillow.
I know about the curse, she mumbled.
Why do you think I kept saying your name?
